children: SENAAT - ANNOUNCES FINANCIAL IMPACT FROM REVISED ELECTRICITY AND WATER SERVICE TARIFFS
SENAAT: EXPECTS APRROX. INCREASE OF 0.14% IN TOTAL COST OF SALES, BASED ON COMPANY’S 2027 PLAN
SENAAT: NO MATERIAL FINANCIAL IMPACT IS EXPECTED FROM UPDATED WATER CONSUMPTION TARIFF
SENAAT: WILL CONTINUE TO IMPLEMENT MEASURES TO IMPROVE OPERATIONAL EFFICIENCY, ENERGY CONSERVATION TO MITIGATE THE IMPACT OF THESE INCREASED COSTS
